name: FLA_PAYMENT_ACCOUNTS_INT
description: FLA_PAYMENT_ACCOUNTS_INT contains the payment accounts information like account class, ledger and code combination id attached to the account class etc

columns.name: INTERFACE_PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Interface Payment accounts identifier. This column consistutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_PAYMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Interface Payment header identifier. Payment header to which the account details belongs to.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease_id references the key of FLA_LEASES_INT to denote that this specific distribution belongs to the lease associated with.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier as defined in General Ledger.

columns.name: LEDGER_NAME
columns.description: Ledger name as defined in General Ledger.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Account identifier. It identifies the row in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this distribution.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CODE_COMBINATION
columns.description: Account concatinated segments. It identifies the row in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this distribution.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Account class of the account in this distribution.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_DETAIL_NUM
columns.description: Account detail number. It is unique within the payment header.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_AMOUNT_PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of the amount from the payment term corresponding to this distribution.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
